caseName: Exxon Corp. v. Federal Trade Commission
caseNameFull: Exxon Corp. v. Federal Trade Commission Kerr-McGee Corp. v. Federal Trade Commission and Union Carbide Corp. v. Federal Trade Commission

opinions.text:
Applications for stay pending appeal to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit, presented to The Chief Justice, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Mr. Justice Stewart and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these applications.
